title: Living
summary: A longer stay still uses the same practical pages: where to sleep, how to pay, and how to get online. Residence permits and tax residency are not set out here.

sections.heading: Start with the practical pages
paragraphs: Read where to stay, money, and SIM and Wi-Fi before you arrange a month in one city. Those pages cover a visitor stay. They do not cover a residence permit.
Confirm permits with the official authority. A forum post is not a source for this site.
